moduleDescription: Web glue for Genzimnify — compiled to JavaScript with nim js. Exposes a single global compileGzim(source) -> json-string used by the static site: transpiles .gzim to Python and reports cap (diagnostics).

entries.name: compileGzim
entries.code:
proc compileGzim(source: cstring): cstring {.exportc, raises: [Exception],
    tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
entries.description: Transpile Genzimnify source to Python; never throws — returns a JSON envelope: {ok, code?, error?, line?, col?, diags: {line, col, message}}
